single_day_update.update_timing: Decision before new day release uses before version. Only after this dated day closes can the after version be fitted. Any comparison uses a later untouched interval.

fit.demand_method: weekday-shrunk log-linear fit + adjacent residual AR(1) conditional moments converted to OU parameters
fit.thermal_method: bounded least-squares grid for RC conductance rate; conditional linear fit for cooling gain

limitations: These observations are a generated synthetic extension, not real MR DIY operational records.
Stock/processing-censored fulfilled sales are excluded; latent lost demand is never fitted.
Small rolling-window weekday and OU estimates are approximate; process/observation noise are not separately identifiable.
Fatigue, service and reward weights stay authored; they are not fitted from these records.
Thermal model is a one-zone lumped RC assumption, not a validated building model.

before.prediction_rule: Frozen weekday level; thermal one-step prediction from current measured initial/forcing. Test rows never enter either fit.

after.prediction_rule: Frozen weekday level; thermal one-step prediction from current measured initial/forcing. Test rows never enter either fit.

limitations: The new released day is authored synthetic evidence, not a connected company feed.
A rolling-window update both adds the new day and drops its oldest day.
Updating parameters can worsen heldout fit; the actual before/after metrics must remain visible.

coupled_dynamics.world_generation_basis: This dynamics-only replay is generated from the fitted synthetic model. It is not an independent business-policy performance test.
coupled_dynamics.policy: Fixed authored daily schedule. No learned policy is implied by this dynamics-only report.
limitations: All operational trajectories and reward coefficients are synthetic.
Weather forcing in this module is authored synthetic noise; official weather evidence remains a separate labeled source.
Lost demand and conditional costs are evaluator diagnostics; they never enter policy observation.
Base staffing, fatigue, thermal zone and service queue are simplified authored assumptions.
An optional trained PINN replaces workday RC segments only within its validated domain; exact RC is baseline and fallback.

pinn_training_and_validation.governing_constraint: dy/dx + y = 0, x=k*t; one-zone constant-forcing RC thermal decay

training.loss: mean ODE residual squared + 2*mean sparse synthetic data error squared

limitations: True trained physics-informed network on a known authored scalar ODE, not a conservation label.
Sparse training labels are exact synthetic ODE samples, not real thermometers.
Exact RC solver is simpler and more accurate; PINN is an optional portable demonstration, not an operational fidelity improvement.
No extrapolation outside x in [0,3.6]; exact solver remains production demonstration fallback.

thermal_neural_comparison.interpretation: PINN is a genuinely trained portable approximation to this assumed scalar RC ODE. Exact analytic RC is simpler and more accurate; no speed or operational-fidelity superiority is claimed.
